name: build nf-tui from pi-tui
summary: Replace console.log/error with pi-tui output paths: (1) scrollable area = Text component with array accumulator (push/shift, capped at N lines), setText(lines.join(newline)); (2) fixed footer = bottom-left overlay Text; (3) watch panel = Text below scroll area, hidden via setText('') which returns []. All console args stringify at boundary.

rawActions.summary: Implement ReplRenderer for nf-tui.ts and rewrite repl.ts to use it. Layout: log→scrollable Text (top); logTo('watch')→watch Text (initial '(watch...)'); error→error Text (initial '(no errors...)'); input line ('nf> ') at bottom. ReplRenderer owns TUI lifecycle. /quit, /exit, or Ctrl-C exits cleanly. Watch panel uses placeholder — watch updates handled by future cli-view command.
